changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6b item 2 (R48): deleted the team.hooks.created plugin hook end-to-end, together with its background scheduling (fireCreated), its InFlightWork-backed in-flight tracking, and the Dispatcher shutdown drain that awaited it. A plugin that tapped this hook loses it; nothing in this tree taps it today, and Dispatcher shutdown no longer waits on it.
